title: Sorting by Color
short: Sort and count things by color.

blocks.html: Sorting means putting things that are alike together. Let’s sort by color: all the red ones here, all the blue ones there!

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: Which ones are red? Which are blue?

blocks.html: Things that are the same color go together.

For the grown-up: Sort laundry by color, crayons into cups, or toy cars by color. Ask “How did you sort them?” There can be more than one good way. A few problems on the screen is plenty. The real practice is with things you can touch.

items: Try it at home: Sort socks by color.
Sort crayons or blocks into colored bowls.
Count how many red things are on the table.
